caption: Quiet hotel room workout: five moves, ten minutes, one wall and a doorframe. A complete strength session between landing and dinner, and the room next door hears nothing. Save it for your next trip.

voiceover.text: Five moves. Ten minutes. One hotel wall.
This room already has everything a complete strength session needs.
Wall push-ups. Ten reps. Hands flat, body in one line, press the wall away.
Doorframe lean rows. Ten reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull yourself in.
Wall sit. Thirty seconds. Back on the wall, slide down, hold.
Glute bridges on the floor. Ten reps. Slow up, slow down.
Wall plank. Twenty seconds. Then repeat the whole round once.
That is the full session, in silence, before dinner. Which city are you in tonight? Tell me in the comments.
